title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with only the apps:edit permission could install a…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with a role limited to the apps:edit permission can exploit a vulnerability to install a connector app that writes attacker-controlled files outside the intended app directory. This allows modification of files used by Splunk SOAR and execution of arbitrary code with the privileges of the Splunk SOAR user account. The issue arises because the dependency installation command is constructed from app metadata without proper validation, enabling argument manipulation.
